description: Permanent Mall product record standard for the Signature Cyber Mega-Mall. Every product is one Mall ID -> one product -> one origin -> one source -> one status -> one version -> one hash -> one canonical URL. Price, license, availability and ownership are separate fields; PRICE=$0 never implies an open license.

department.description: Mall department (floor). One of the published departments.

license.description: License text or status of the source record.

mall_id.description: Permanent Mall ID. Never reused, never changed on rename, never recycled.

origin.description: original = made by Justin Addam Higgins / the Signature system; generated = produced by his deterministic generators; external = real public record harvested from public sources.

owner.description: Owner of the source record; Mall listing does not imply Mall ownership.

product_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization (see products-schema.json).

provenance.description: How this Mall record came to exist: harvester name/version, ingestion date.

source_record_id.description: ID of the record on its source site (e.g. JAH-AI-DOM-001).

source_site.description: Human-readable source site name; Mall identity stays separate from source-site identity.

source_url.description: Deep link to the EXACT source record, not the source homepage.

title: JAH-MALL-RECORD/1.0

version_history.note: Initial permanent standard. Origin enum covers the three observed harvester values; extensible with a minor version bump.
